title: Automate legal questionnaire triage and escrow/ liability approval flow
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background:
Customers increasingly submit detailed security & commercial questionnaires (SaaSQ, SEC, custom RFPs) that frequently surface liability/indemnity and data processing exceptions. Sales and Solutions teams spend significant cycle time manually triaging questionnaires and coordinating redlines with Legal. This creates sales friction, inconsistent risk decisions, and ad-hoc pricing concessions.

Goal:
Design and implement an automated triage + approval workflow that:
- Parses incoming legal/security questionnaires and scores risk vectors (liability cap, indemnity, data residency, escrow requests).
- Applies deterministic routing rules: auto-approve low-risk items, route medium/high to delegated approvers, escalate critical exceptions to General Counsel.
- Triggers pricing/packaging guardrails: where certain redlines require reserved capacity contracts, higher AR commitments, or escrow/escrow+SLA charges surfaced to Sales.
- Produces pre-populated redline templates (MSA/DPA) and a recommended concession + pricing delta for Sales Ops to accept or counter.

Scope & Out of Scope:
In scope: questionnaire ingestion pipeline, risk-scoring engine ruleset, routing rules for Legal/Sales Ops, redline template generation for MSA/DPA, pricing delta mapping for common concession buckets, Slack/Linear notifications, audit log entries.
Out of scope: full natural-language negotiation automation, escrow fund handling (ops/legal will handle settlement), integration with external e-signature provider (separate ticket).

Proposed workflow (high level):
1) Intake: Sales/Customer uploads questionnaire into the Contract Intake form (Confluence form + S3 upload or email parser).
2) Parser & classifier: NLP + rules parse the PDF/Doc, extract answers, and normalize to a standard questionnaire schema.
3) Risk scoring: rule engine assigns risk level for each axis (liability cap, indemnity reciprocity, PCI/PHI flags, export control, escrow request). The engine produces an aggregate score and a list of triggered rule IDs.
4) Routing: based on score and triggered rule IDs:
   - Low: auto-generate recommended redline and approval stamp; notify Sales and auto-apply to templated MSA/DPA.
   - Medium: route to delegated legal reviewer (playbook includes example redlines + pricing delta suggestions).
   - High: escalate to GC + require <stakeholder> signoff; mark as deal-blocker in CRM.
5) Pricing mapping: for each concession bucket, Surface recommended commercial offsets (e.g., 12-month reserved commit, 1.25x unit price, dedicated capacity surcharge, or escrow setup fee). These are editable by Sales Ops before sending to customer.
6) Output: issue summary, attached pre-filled redline, recommended pricing adjustments, and audit trail stored in Contract Log.

Acceptance criteria (must all be met):
- Ingestion pipeline extracts at least 85% of fields from the standard vendor questionnaire for 5 representative customer docs (measured by field-level F1).
- Risk scoring ruleset implemented with 12 initial rules; decision coverage matches Legal signoff scenarios in 80% of a 20-ticket test batch.
- Routing logic correctly moves tickets into three corridors (Auto-approve, Delegated legal, GC escalation) in a pilot across Sales West region for 2 weeks without manual override errors.
- UI/UX: Sales form displays recommended redline + pricing delta and allows one-click accept/return for edits.
- Auditability: every decision stores rule IDs and source document link in the Contract Log with timestamp and acting user.
- Security: any document containing PHI or export control flags triggers an immediate GC notification and marks security_review_required = true.

Non-functional requirements:
- Latency: parsing + scoring should complete within 3 minutes for standard questionnaire <= 8 pages.
- Reliability: 99% availability for intake endpoints during Sales hours.
- Data retention: redlines and logs retained per the contracts-retention policy (Confluence link in links).
acceptance_criteria: Parser extracts >=85% of canonical fields for sample docs (field F1 >=0.85)
Ruleset coverage aligns with Legal signoff in >=80% of pilot cases
Routing lanes function correctly in West region pilot for 2 weeks
Sales UI displays editable pricing delta and redline template
Audit log entries for every automated decision with rule references

2025-03-14 - Legal (J. Rivera) provided priority rule list: liability cap thresholds, indemnity reciprocity, escrow requests, PHI/PCI flags.
2025-03-15 - Engineering (Luca) prototype parser PR opened (github PR #94). Initial extractor hits ~72% on quick test corpus.
2025-03-16 - Pricing: Sales Ops proposed three concession buckets and associated pricing multipliers; need legal signoff on mapping.

risks: NLP extraction accuracy for scanned or heavily redacted PDFs could be below thresholds, requiring manual review backlog.
Over-automation risk: automated approvals could miss nuanced commercial context; mitigate by conservative default routing and human-in-loop for medium/high.
Interplay with pricing experiments: automatic delta suggestions may conflict with running packaging experiments; coordinate with Growth to avoid unintended churn.
Legal resourcing: surge of medium/high escalations could overwhelm delegated reviewers during pilot.
